key_lines: Our client is a growing construction consultancy business delivering a diverse portfolio of projects across the retail, education, commercial and industrial sectors. They have a good reputation locally and are proud of the amount of repeat business they secure based on quality of their work and relationships they are able to develop. As their current cadet moves into more senior role, they are looking to backfill the role with a construction cadet / junior PM

Working alongside experienced project professionals, you will assist in the planning, coordination and delivery of projects from early planning stages through to completion. You will gain exposure to a broad range of stakeholders, project types and responsibilities.

The ideal candidate will be currently studying or have recently completed a degree in Construction Management or Quantity Surveying and must have some - suggest minimum 12 months working as CA for main contractor or sub contractor business.

Strong communication and interpersonal skills are essential, along with excellent organisation, attention to detail and a proactive approach to problem solving. Candidates should be motivated to develop their technical knowledge and capable of building effective working relationships with consultants, contractors and clients. A current driver's licence is required.

This is an opportunity to join a growing business with an excellent reputation and gain exposure to a diverse range of high-quality projects and clients. You will work alongside experienced industry professionals who are committed to providing mentorship, guidance and ongoing professional development.

The business offers a supportive and collaborative team culture, regular social events and clear opportunities for long-term career progression. You will gain valuable exposure to the full project lifecycle while developing the technical, commercial and stakeholder management skills required for a successful career in the construction industry.

If you're interested in this role, click 'apply now' to forward an up-to-date copy of your CV, or call us now. If this job isn't quite right for you, but you are looking for a new position, please contact us for a confidential discussion on your career.
